posts.title: A Small Architecture for AI Products
posts.summary: A durable AI product needs a source of truth, explicit boundaries, evaluation, and a human decision loop.
posts.body:
A Small Architecture for AI Products

English

A useful AI product architecture can be described as a loop: input, evidence, model or rule, human decision, output, and evaluation. Each boundary should be visible enough that a person can explain what happened and recover from a bad result.

The source of truth should be explicit. Data needs a defined shape, permissions need a clear owner, and generated output needs a status that distinguishes a draft from an approved action. Observability belongs in the first design rather than after the first incident.

This structure is intentionally small. It gives a prototype a path toward a product without hiding uncertainty behind a chat interface.

中文

一个实用的 AI 产品架构可以看成一个循环：输入、证据、模型或规则、人工决策、输出和评估。每个边界都应该足够清楚，让人能够解释发生了什么，并在结果错误时恢复。

系统必须有明确的 source of truth。数据要有定义，权限要有负责人，生成结果要区分草稿和已批准动作。可观测性应该从第一版设计开始，而不是等事故发生后再补。

这个结构刻意保持小而清晰，让原型可以走向产品，同时不把不确定性藏在聊天界面后面。

posts.title: Thinking Before Building
posts.summary: A reliable product process starts by checking the question before optimizing the answer.
posts.body:
Thinking Before Building

English

AI can execute quickly, but speed does not automatically correct a wrong premise. If the first question is framed badly, a highly capable system may produce a polished answer to the wrong problem.

A useful habit is to separate three moves: define the decision, inspect the assumptions, and only then choose the tool. This keeps execution connected to purpose. It also creates a clear place to pause when the evidence is weak.

For product work, critical thinking is not a ceremonial review step. It is a small feedback loop that protects time, user trust, and the meaning of the result.

中文

AI 可以很快执行，但速度不会自动修正错误前提。如果第一个问题的 framing 就不准确，高能力系统可能只是更快地把错误问题包装成漂亮答案。

一个实用习惯是把三个动作分开：先定义决策，再检查假设，最后选择工具。这样执行过程始终和目的相连，也能在证据不足时留下暂停和复核的位置。

对产品工作来说，批判性思维不是形式化的审查步骤，而是保护时间、用户信任和结果意义的小型反馈回路。

posts.title: Define the Dataset Before Training
posts.summary: Prediction unit, input window, target, and leakage rules define what a model is actually learning.
posts.body:
Define the Dataset Before Training

English

Before training a model, define the prediction unit, input window, target, and the moment when the prediction is allowed to exist. These choices determine whether a feature is available at decision time.

A field that appears predictive can still be invalid if it contains information from the future. Writing the data contract first makes training-serving skew and leakage easier to detect.

The model is only one part of the system. The dataset definition is where the meaning of the prediction begins.

中文

训练模型前，要先定义 prediction unit、input window、target，以及预测可以发生的时间点。这些选择决定某个 feature 在真实决策时是否可用。

一个看似有预测力的字段，如果包含未来信息，仍然是不合法的。先写数据契约，能更容易发现 training-serving skew 和 leakage。

模型只是系统的一部分，预测的意义从数据定义开始。

posts.title: Design Learning as a System
posts.summary: Progress becomes visible when learning has bounded questions, artifacts, and feedback.
posts.body:
Design Learning as a System

English

Learning becomes easier to continue when it has a bounded question, a small artifact, and a feedback point. The artifact can be a working prototype, a written explanation, or a failed experiment with a clear lesson.

A long list of technologies is not a learning system. A system connects a question to an action, records what happened, and uses the result to choose the next step.

This is also why a personal knowledge graph should show progress, not only accumulate notes. Links should help a visitor see how ideas lead to experiments and how experiments revise ideas.

中文

当学习有一个边界清楚的问题、一个小型产物和一个反馈点时，更容易持续。产物可以是可运行原型、书面解释，或一个带有清晰教训的失败实验。

技术清单不是学习系统。系统应该把问题连接到行动，记录发生了什么，再用结果选择下一步。

这也是个人知识图谱不应只堆积笔记的原因。链接应该帮助访客看见想法如何导向实验，以及实验如何反过来修正想法。

posts.title: Human Value in the Agent Era
posts.summary: When tools become widely available, judgment and direction become more visible forms of craft.
posts.body:
Human Value in the Agent Era

English

As agents become better at routine execution, the scarce part of work moves upstream. People still need to choose what matters, notice weak evidence, decide what should remain under human control, and give a result a coherent direction.

This does not make implementation less important. It changes the relationship between implementation and judgment. A strong builder can move between a user need, a system boundary, a prototype, and a test that reveals whether the idea deserves more work.

The useful question is not whether a tool can do a task. It is whether the task should be automated, what evidence is required, and how a person can recover when the system is wrong.

中文

当 agent 越来越擅长重复执行，稀缺部分会向上游移动。人仍然需要选择什么重要、识别证据是否薄弱、决定哪些事情必须由人控制，并让结果拥有一致的方向。

这并不意味着实现变得不重要，而是实现和判断之间的关系发生了变化。好的 builder 能在用户需求、系统边界、原型和验证实验之间切换。

真正有用的问题不是工具能不能完成某个任务，而是这项任务是否应该自动化、需要什么证据，以及系统出错时人如何恢复。

posts.title: State Is a Compact Memory
posts.summary: A Markov model asks whether the present state contains enough information to estimate the next step.
posts.body:
State Is a Compact Memory

English

A Markov model treats the current state as a compact summary of the past. The next transition depends on that state rather than the full history. The simplification is powerful because it makes a complex process easier to simulate and reason about.

The question is whether the chosen state actually preserves the information that changes the next outcome. If it does not, the model may look elegant while missing an important memory effect.

Good modeling therefore includes a question about what the state leaves out, not only a calculation of what it predicts.

中文

Markov 模型把当前状态当成过去的压缩摘要，下一次转移依赖这个状态，而不是完整历史。这个简化很有用，因为它让复杂过程更容易被模拟和解释。

关键问题是：选定的状态是否真的保留了会改变下一结果的信息。如果没有，模型可能看起来很优雅，却忽略重要的记忆效应。

因此，好的建模不仅要计算它预测什么，也要追问这个状态遗漏了什么。

posts.title: Repetition Makes Uncertainty Visible
posts.summary: Monte Carlo simulation turns a single plausible run into a distribution of possible outcomes.
posts.body:
Repetition Makes Uncertainty Visible

English

A single simulation run can look persuasive because it tells a clean story. Monte Carlo repetition is a simple correction: run the same model many times with a controlled random seed or a documented sampling rule, then inspect the distribution of outcomes.

The result is not a prediction with a magical guarantee. It is a view of how much the answer changes when uncertainty in the inputs is allowed to move through the system.

This is useful for product decisions because it changes the conversation from “what number will happen?” to “which outcomes are plausible, and what decision remains safe across them?”

中文

一次模拟运行很容易让人信服，因为它会讲出一个完整故事。Monte Carlo 重复实验提供了简单修正：用受控随机种子或明确的采样规则重复运行同一个模型，再观察结果分布。

它不是带有神奇保证的预测，而是展示当输入不确定性穿过系统时，答案会变化多少。

对产品决策来说，这会把问题从“最终会是多少”改成“哪些结果是合理的，在这些结果下什么决策仍然安全”。

posts.title: Consent Is a Product Boundary
posts.summary: Data access is trustworthy when people can understand what is requested, why it is needed, and how to revoke it.
posts.body:
Consent Is a Product Boundary

English

OAuth is not just a technical handshake. It is a product boundary where a person decides whether an application may access a specific scope of data.

A clear consent experience explains the purpose, limits the scope, avoids surprising aggregation, and makes revocation discoverable. The system should preserve the permission decision as evidence instead of treating it as an invisible implementation detail.

When the product cannot explain what it will do with the data, the correct response is to narrow the request or stop.

中文

OAuth 不只是技术握手，它也是一个产品边界：用户决定应用是否可以访问特定范围的数据。

清晰的 consent 体验应该说明用途、限制范围、避免意外的数据聚合，并让撤销权限变得容易找到。系统应保存这个权限决定作为证据，而不是把它藏在实现细节里。

如果产品无法解释会怎样使用数据，正确做法是缩小请求范围或停止。

posts.title: Capacity Is a Product Decision
posts.summary: Arrival rate, service rate, and queue length translate system behavior into a user experience.
posts.body:
Capacity Is a Product Decision

English

A queue grows when arrivals persistently outpace service. The equation is simple, but the product effect is not: users experience the imbalance as waiting, uncertainty, retries, or abandonment.

Capacity work should connect system measures to user outcomes. A faster backend may matter less than a clear progress state, an honest limit, or a graceful fallback when demand spikes.

This is why performance is also a design question. The system and the interface share responsibility for making delay understandable.

中文

当到达速度持续超过服务速度时，队列就会增长。公式很简单，但产品影响并不简单：用户会把失衡感受到等待、不确定性、重试或离开。

容量分析应该把系统指标和用户结果连接起来。后端变快固然有用，但在需求高峰时，一个清晰的进度状态、诚实的限制或优雅的 fallback 可能更重要。

因此性能也是设计问题。系统和界面共同负责让延迟变得可理解。

posts.title: Reproducibility Is Part of the Result
posts.summary: A simulation is easier to trust when another person can rerun it and understand its inputs.
posts.body:
Reproducibility Is Part of the Result

English

A result without its input definition is difficult to evaluate. For a simulation, reproducibility means naming the unit of analysis, documenting the distribution or event rule, recording the random seed, and keeping the transformation steps visible.

This is not paperwork for its own sake. It makes debugging faster and helps a team distinguish a genuine change from a changed assumption or a lucky run.

The same principle applies to AI products: record the version of the prompt, model, data slice, and evaluation criteria that produced an output.

中文

没有输入定义的结果很难评估。对模拟来说，可复现意味着说明分析单位、记录分布或事件规则、保存随机种子，并让变换步骤保持可见。

这不是为了增加文书工作，而是为了更快调试，让团队区分真正的改进、假设变化和一次幸运运行。

同样的原则适用于 AI 产品：记录生成结果所使用的 prompt、模型、数据切片和评估标准版本。

posts.title: Synthetic Data Is a Hypothesis, Not Reality
posts.summary: Synthetic users are useful for testing mechanisms, but external validation still needs real evidence.
posts.body:
Synthetic Data Is a Hypothesis, Not Reality

English

Synthetic data is valuable when the question is about a mechanism: how a system behaves under controlled inputs, how a queue fills, or how a recommendation policy changes exposure. It lets a team repeat an experiment and inspect edge cases without exposing real people.

The boundary is just as important. A synthetic result can show that an implementation behaves consistently under its assumptions. It cannot, by itself, prove that those assumptions describe a real population or that a product improves a real outcome.

The honest workflow is to label what is simulated, preserve the assumptions, and plan the smallest external check that could challenge them.

中文

当问题关注机制时，合成数据很有价值：系统如何对受控输入作出反应、队列如何增长、推荐策略如何改变曝光。它让团队可以重复实验并检查边界情况，同时不暴露真实用户。

边界同样重要。合成结果可以说明实现会在给定假设下保持一致，但不能单独证明这些假设代表真实人群，也不能证明产品改善了真实结果。

更诚实的工作流是标记哪些内容是模拟的、保留假设，并设计最小的外部验证去挑战这些假设。
